descriptionChirho: Spatial/positional preposition indicating location in front of or in the presence of someone, used across all pronominal suffixes in biblical Aramaic contexts (Daniel, Ezra) with consistent multilingual evidence: Arabic أَمَامَ/قُدَّامَ, Spanish delante de, Hindi के सामने, Swahili mbele ya.

Temporal preposition meaning 'prior to in time,' distinguished from the spatial sense by multilingual evidence: Arabic قَبْلَهُ (temporal 'before'), Spanish antes de ella (temporal), Hindi उससे पहले के ('before that' in time), Swahili kabla yake (temporal 'before').
